for \(j = 1,\ldots ,k\) (repeat over values of \(\gamma\) in \(\Gamma\)) do  
for \(i = 1,\ldots ,10\) (10-fold cross-validation loop) do  
Compute \(w_{i}(\gamma_{j})\in \arg \min_{w}\ell (w,S_{-i}) + \lambda f(w,S_{-i}) + \gamma_{j}\| w\|_{2}\)  
\(\triangleright\) train a model \(w_{i}(\gamma_{j})\) on all the data except fold \(i\)  
Set \(\mathrm{Loss}(i,j) = \ell (w_i(\gamma_j),S_i) + \lambda f(w_i(\gamma_j),S_i)\)  
\(\triangleright\) record the test loss of the computed model \(w_{i}(\gamma_{j})\) on fold \(i\)  
\(L(j) = L(j) + \mathrm{Loss}(i,j)\).  
\(\triangleright\) add the test loss to the total loss of \(\gamma_{j}\) so far.
